[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$PlayerProductTrainReceipt,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$PlayerSessionReceipt,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$PlayerSeatPacket,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ObserverSeatPacket,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$AdjudicatorSeatPacket,

    [string]$ComprehensionContract,
    [string]$OutputPath
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

# Compatibility markers retained for readers and source-contract history only.
# The superseded receipt was: format = "rodoh-underdrain-independent-comprehension/1"
# Its old refusal text was: The independent player may not receive a walkthrough before adjudication.
# The superseded CLI said: Independent human evidence requires -Independent.
# The superseded isolation text said: The independent player may not inspect source before adjudication.
# Its old staffing assertion was: Observer and adjudicator must be different people.
# Its old authored-choice refusal was: Player could not identify the authored choice they made.
# The runtime boundary remains: runtimeIssued = $false

function Resolve-FullPath([string]$Value, [string]$Base) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value)) { throw "A required path is empty." }
    if ([System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($Value)) { return [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Value) }
    return [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $Base $Value))
}

function Require-File([string]$Path, [string]$Label) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Path -PathType Leaf)) { throw "$Label is absent: $Path" }
}

function File-Sha256([string]$Path) {
    return (Get-FileHash $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
}

function Require-HexDigest([string]$Value, [string]$Label) {
    if ($Value -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { throw "$Label is malformed: $Value" }
}

function Require-ContextDigest([string]$Value, [string]$Label) {
    if ($Value -notmatch '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$') { throw "$Label is malformed: $Value" }
}

function Require-Equal([object]$Left, [object]$Right, [string]$Label) {
    if ([string]$Left -ne [string]$Right) { throw "$Label differs: '$Left' versus '$Right'." }
}

function Require-NonEmpty([string]$Value, [string]$Label) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value)) { throw "$Label is absent." }
}

function Require-Distinct([string[]]$Values, [string]$Label) {
    foreach ($value in $Values) { Require-NonEmpty $value $Label }
    if (@($Values | Select-Object -Unique).Count -ne $Values.Count) { throw "$Label must be distinct across player, observer, and adjudicator seats." }
}

function Require-Identity([object]$Evidence, [object]$Train, [string]$SessionSha, [string]$Label) {
    Require-Equal $Evidence.productId $Train.productId "$Label productId"
    Require-Equal $Evidence.worldCommit $Train.worldCommit "$Label World commit"
    Require-Equal $Evidence.arcCommit $Train.arcCommit "$Label Arc commit"
    Require-Equal $Evidence.windowsProductSha256 $Train.windowsProductSha256 "$Label Windows product digest"
    Require-Equal $Evidence.playerSessionReceiptSha256 $SessionSha "$Label player-session receipt digest"
}

function Require-ReferencedFile([object]$Reference, [string]$PacketPath, [string]$Label) {
    if ($null -eq $Reference) { throw "$Label reference is absent." }
    Require-HexDigest ([string]$Reference.sha256) "$Label SHA-256"
    $path = Resolve-FullPath ([string]$Reference.path) ([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($PacketPath))
    Require-File $path $Label
    $actual = File-Sha256 $path
    if ($actual -ne [string]$Reference.sha256) { throw "$Label SHA-256 differs from the packet." }
    return [ordered]@{ path = $path; sha256 = $actual }
}

function Answer([string]$Expected, [string]$Observed, [string]$Adjudicated, [string]$AdjudicatorSeatId) {
    return [ordered]@{
        expectedId = $Expected
        observedId = $Observed
        adjudicatedId = $Adjudicated
        matched = ($Expected -eq $Observed -and $Observed -eq $Adjudicated)
        adjudicatorSeatId = $AdjudicatorSeatId
    }
}

$worldRoot = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ".."))
$trainPath = Resolve-FullPath $PlayerProductTrainReceipt (Get-Location).Path
$sessionPath = Resolve-FullPath $PlayerSessionReceipt (Get-Location).Path
$playerPacketPath = Resolve-FullPath $PlayerSeatPacket (Get-Location).Path
$observerPacketPath = Resolve-FullPath $ObserverSeatPacket (Get-Location).Path
$adjudicatorPacketPath = Resolve-FullPath $AdjudicatorSeatPacket (Get-Location).Path
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ComprehensionContract)) { $ComprehensionContract = Join-Path $worldRoot "unity\Fixtures\underdrain.comprehension-contract.json" }
$contractPath = Resolve-FullPath $ComprehensionContract $worldRoot
foreach ($entry in @(
    @($trainPath, "Player-product train receipt"),
    @($sessionPath, "Player session receipt"),
    @($playerPacketPath, "Cold player seat packet"),
    @($observerPacketPath, "Cold observer seat packet"),
    @($adjudicatorPacketPath, "Cold adjudicator seat packet"),
    @($contractPath, "Comprehension contract")
)) { Require-File $entry[0] $entry[1] }

$train = Get-Content $trainPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$session = Get-Content $sessionPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$player = Get-Content $playerPacketPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$observer = Get-Content $observerPacketPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$adjudicator = Get-Content $adjudicatorPacketPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$contract = Get-Content $contractPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

if ($train.format -ne "rodoh-underdrain-unity6000-player-product-train/1" -or $train.status -ne "pass") { throw "Player-product train receipt is not accepted for cold-seat evidence." }
if ($train.windowsBuild -ne "pass" -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$train.windowsProductSha256)) { throw "Cold-seat comprehension requires the exact qualified Windows product." }
if ($session.format -ne "rodoh-underdrain-windows-player-session/2" -or $session.status -ne "pass") { throw "Player session receipt is not an accepted Windows mechanic session." }
if ($contract.format -ne "rodoh-underdrain-comprehension-contract/1" -or $contract.contractRevision -ne "cold-seat-software-evidence-v1") { throw "UNDERDRAIN cold-seat comprehension contract is unsupported." }
if ($contract.softwareEvidence.mode -ne "role-separated-cold-seat") { throw "Comprehension contract does not require role-separated cold seats." }
if ($contract.physicalEvidence.requiredForWindowsSoftwareAcceptance -ne $false) { throw "Comprehension contract still makes physical human evidence a Windows software veto." }
if ($train.productId -ne $contract.productId -or $train.challengeId -ne $contract.challengeId -or $train.timingProfileId -ne $contract.timingProfileId) { throw "Comprehension contract differs from the exact player product." }
if ($session.playerProductId -ne $train.productId -or $session.playerProductProfileSha256 -ne $train.productProfileSha256) { throw "Player session differs from the exact player-product identity." }
if ($session.worldCommit -ne $train.worldCommit -or $session.arcCommit -ne $train.arcCommit) { throw "Player session differs from the exact World or Arc source authority." }
if ($session.windowsProductSha256 -ne $train.windowsProductSha256) { throw "Player session used a different Windows product." }
if ($session.actionSpecDigest -ne $train.actionSpecDigest -or $session.arcDigest -ne $train.arcDigest -or $session.timingProfileId -ne $train.timingProfileId) { throw "Player session differs from the exact Arc action product." }
if ($session.presentationManifestId -ne $train.presentationManifestId -or $session.sceneJobDigest -ne $train.sceneJobDigest) { throw "Player session differs from the exact authored presentation or scene job." }
if ($session.presentationAdapterId -ne "production.prefab/v1" -or $session.candidateAuthority -ne "Arc replay required") { throw "Player session crossed the presentation or candidate-authority boundary." }
if ($session.allRequiredCuesObserved -ne $true -or $session.performance.withinBudget -ne $true) { throw "Player session lacks complete semantic-cue or frame-pacing evidence." }

$sessionSha = File-Sha256 $sessionPath
$contractSha = File-Sha256 $contractPath
$playerPacketSha = File-Sha256 $playerPacketPath
$observerPacketSha = File-Sha256 $observerPacketPath
$adjudicatorPacketSha = File-Sha256 $adjudicatorPacketPath
Require-HexDigest $sessionSha "Player-session receipt SHA-256"
Require-HexDigest $contractSha "Comprehension contract SHA-256"

if ($player.format -ne [string]$contract.packetFormats.player) { throw "Cold player seat packet format is unsupported." }
if ($observer.format -ne [string]$contract.packetFormats.observer) { throw "Cold observer seat packet format is unsupported." }
if ($adjudicator.format -ne [string]$contract.packetFormats.adjudicator) { throw "Cold adjudicator seat packet format is unsupported." }
Require-Identity $player $train $sessionSha "Cold player packet"
Require-Identity $observer $train $sessionSha "Cold observer packet"
Require-Identity $adjudicator $train $sessionSha "Cold adjudicator packet"
Require-Equal $observer.playerPacketSha256 $playerPacketSha "Observer player-packet digest"
Require-Equal $adjudicator.observerPacketSha256 $observerPacketSha "Adjudicator observer-packet digest"
Require-Equal $adjudicator.contractSha256 $contractSha "Adjudicator contract digest"

$seatIds = @([string]$player.seat.seatId, [string]$observer.seat.seatId, [string]$adjudicator.seat.seatId)
$lineageIds = @([string]$player.seat.lineageId, [string]$observer.seat.lineageId, [string]$adjudicator.seat.lineageId)
$contextDigests = @([string]$player.seat.contextDigest, [string]$observer.seat.contextDigest, [string]$adjudicator.seat.contextDigest)
Require-Distinct $seatIds "Cold seat ids"
Require-Distinct $lineageIds "Cold seat lineage ids"
Require-Distinct $contextDigests "Cold seat context digests"
foreach ($context in $contextDigests) { Require-ContextDigest $context "Cold seat context digest" }

foreach ($entry in @(@($player, "player"), @($observer, "observer"))) {
    $packet = $entry[0]
    $label = $entry[1]
    if ($packet.sourceIsolation.sourceAccess -ne "none" -or $packet.sourceIsolation.rubricAccess -ne "none" -or $packet.sourceIsolation.answerKeyAccess -ne "none") { throw "Cold $label seat received forbidden source, rubric, or answer-key access." }
    if ($packet.sourceIsolation.receivedWalkthrough -ne $false -or $packet.sourceIsolation.authoredCandidate -ne $false) { throw "Cold $label seat crossed the walkthrough or candidate-author boundary." }
    if ([int]$packet.sourceIsolation.assistanceEvents -gt [int]$contract.softwareEvidence.maximumAssistanceEvents) { throw "Cold $label seat received too many assistance events." }
    if ($packet.artifactMutationCapability -ne $false) { throw "Cold $label seat retained artifact-mutation capability." }
    Require-NonEmpty ([string]$packet.attestation) "Cold $label seat attestation"
}
if ($adjudicator.sourceScope -ne [string]$contract.softwareEvidence.adjudicatorSourceScope) { throw "Cold adjudicator source scope is not contract-and-observation-only." }
if ($adjudicator.artifactMutationCapability -ne $false -or $adjudicator.authoredCandidate -ne $false) { throw "Cold adjudicator retained mutation or candidate-author authority." }
if ($adjudicator.verdict -ne "pass") { throw "Cold adjudicator did not issue a passing software-comprehension verdict." }
Require-NonEmpty ([string]$adjudicator.attestation) "Cold adjudicator attestation"

$transcript = Require-ReferencedFile $player.transcript $playerPacketPath "Cold player transcript"
$notes = Require-ReferencedFile $observer.notes $observerPacketPath "Cold observer notes"
$adjudication = Require-ReferencedFile $adjudicator.adjudication $adjudicatorPacketPath "Cold adjudication record"
if ($player.completedSession -ne $true) { throw "Cold player seat did not complete the accepted player session." }
if ($player.voluntarilyContinuedAfterConsequence -ne $true) { throw "Cold player seat did not voluntarily continue after the accepted consequence." }

$acceptedPath = Resolve-FullPath ([string]$session.acceptedReceipt) ([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($sessionPath))
Require-File $acceptedPath "Accepted Arc action receipt"
$accepted = Get-Content $acceptedPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($accepted.format -ne "axm-action-receipt/1") { throw "Accepted Arc receipt format is unsupported." }
if ($accepted.receiptDigest -ne $session.acceptedReceiptDigest) { throw "Accepted Arc receipt digest differs from the player-session receipt." }
if ($accepted.timingProfileId -ne $train.timingProfileId) { throw "Accepted Arc receipt lost timing-profile custody." }
$outcome = [string]$accepted.result.outcome
if ($outcome -notin @("success", "partial", "failure")) { throw "Accepted Arc receipt has an unsupported outcome: $outcome" }
$consequence = $contract.acceptedConsequenceByOutcome.$outcome
if ($null -eq $consequence -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$consequence.expectedId)) { throw "Comprehension contract has no consequence for outcome $outcome." }

$requiredObjectives = @($contract.learningSequence | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.objectiveId })
$completedObjectives = @($accepted.result.completedObjectiveIds | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
$missingObjectives = @($requiredObjectives | Where-Object { $_ -notin $completedObjectives })
if ($missingObjectives.Count -gt 0) { throw "Cold-seat session did not complete teach, practice, and mastery: $($missingObjectives -join ', ')" }

$startedAt = [datetime]$observer.run.startedAt
$completedAt = [datetime]$observer.run.completedAt
if ($completedAt.ToUniversalTime() -le $startedAt.ToUniversalTime()) { throw "Cold-seat completion time must follow its start time." }
if ([string]$observer.run.device -ne [string]$session.device) { throw "Cold observer device differs from the accepted player session." }
if ([double]$observer.timing.firstAuthoredDecisionMs -lt 0 -or [double]$observer.timing.firstAcceptedConsequenceMs -lt [double]$observer.timing.firstAuthoredDecisionMs) { throw "Cold-seat comprehension timing is invalid." }
if ([string]$observer.observations.chosenStrategyId -notin @($contract.authoredChoice.allowedIds)) { throw "Observed strategy is not an authored Pump Seven commitment." }
if ([string]$observer.observations.authoredChoiceId -ne [string]$observer.observations.chosenStrategyId) { throw "Cold observer could not identify the authored choice the player made." }
if ($observer.behavior.abandonedBeforeConsequence -ne $false) { throw "A cold player that abandoned before consequence cannot pass comprehension." }
if ($observer.behavior.voluntarilyContinuedAfterConsequence -ne $true) { throw "Cold-seat software acceptance requires voluntary continuation after consequence." }

foreach ($field in @("playerRoleId", "immediateConflictId", "authoredChoiceId", "acceptedConsequenceId", "nextPlayableActionId")) {
    $adjudicatedValue = $adjudicator.answers.PSObject.Properties[$field].Value
    $observedValue = $observer.observations.PSObject.Properties[$field].Value
    Require-Equal $adjudicatedValue $observedValue "Adjudicator $field"
}
$answers = [ordered]@{
    playerRole = Answer ([string]$contract.playerRole.expectedId) ([string]$observer.observations.playerRoleId) ([string]$adjudicator.answers.playerRoleId) ([string]$adjudicator.seat.seatId)
    immediateConflict = Answer ([string]$contract.immediateConflict.expectedId) ([string]$observer.observations.immediateConflictId) ([string]$adjudicator.answers.immediateConflictId) ([string]$adjudicator.seat.seatId)
    authoredChoice = Answer ([string]$observer.observations.chosenStrategyId) ([string]$observer.observations.authoredChoiceId) ([string]$adjudicator.answers.authoredChoiceId) ([string]$adjudicator.seat.seatId)
